ashen_floor.prompt: Image 1 shows four floor tiles of a pixel art game, seen from directly above. Create one new floor tile in exactly the same pixel art style, palette, colours, pixel size and level of detail: dark ashen grey stone slabs with thin dark cracks between them, seen straight from above, completely flat, no perspective, no lighting, no shadows, no border, the texture fills the whole image edge to edge and tiles seamlessly when repeated. Very few colours, chunky big pixels.

fireball.prompt: Image 1 shows a tiny pixel art fireball projectile of a game in two animation frames, flying to the right, seen from above. Create a horizontal sprite strip with 4 animation frames side by side in 4 equal columns of the same fireball, in exactly the same pixel art style, palette, colours, chunky pixel size and shape: a round bright yellow-orange core at the right with a flickering red-orange flame tail trailing to the left, the flames shift a little in each frame for a looping flicker. Plain flat pure white background, no shadow, no text, no border.
